ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ وَأَعِذْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ مَا مِنْهُ اسْتَعَاذَ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa a`idhnā min kulli mā min hu ‘sta`ādh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and protect us from everything from which he sought protection!
blocks.review: Source prints the opening words 'and send' of the translation in black at the end of the transliteration line ('‘sta`ādh.and send'); moved to the start of en by meaning.

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ مَعْدِنِ الْأَسْرَارِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ma‘dini ‘l-asrār.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the fountain of secrets!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ووَعَلَى أٰلِهِ مَظْهَرِ الْأَنْوَارِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Maẓhari ‘l-anwār.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the manifestation of lights!
blocks.review: Source prints a doubled wāw after مُحَمَّدٍ (an extra unvowelled و before وَعَلَى), confirmed on zoom; transcribed as printed.
